add.configuredBody: Its settings are saved on this console. Change them, or go on.
add.debridBody: A link or a magnet. {service} fetches it on its servers, and the console downloads the file from there.
add.fieldBody.address: The WebUI's address as host:port, for example 192.168.1.10:8080.
add.fieldBody.password: The WebUI's password. Leave it empty when the WebUI asks for none.
add.fieldBody.premiumize: Your own key, from premiumize.me under Account then API. Each user enters their own.
add.fieldBody.realdebrid: Your own token, from real-debrid.com under My account then API. Each user enters their own.
add.fieldBody.torbox: Your own key, from torbox.app under Settings then API. Each user enters their own.
add.linkBody: A file's own address, or a page of a host Overdrive already handles (VikingFile, DataNodes, FileKeeper). It downloads like a catalog file.
add.linkCardDetail: A pasted link, or your Archive.org account
add.magnetOnly: That is not a magnet link or a .torrent link. Paste one or the other.
add.phone.title: Link it with your phone
add.phone.step1: 1. Scan the code with your phone's camera.
add.phone.step2: 2. Sign in to {service} and approve Overdrive. This page carries on by itself.
add.phone.waiting: Waiting for you to approve it on the phone…
add.phone.linkedBody: Overdrive can use the account now.
add.phone.failed: No code right now. Check the console's connection, then Retry, or enter the key by hand.
add.phone.or: Or enter the key by hand, as before:
add.servicesBody: Pick the service to fetch the file. Each has its own account and key, entered once on this console.
add.setupBody: Entered once on this console. Nothing is sent anywhere else, and every user has their own.
add.setupClientHint: No qBittorrent? A debrid service takes magnets too: send one from its card.
add.title: ADD A DOWNLOAD
add.torrentBody: Paste a magnet, or a link ending in .torrent. Your qBittorrent fetches it, and the console downloads the finished file from there.
add.torrentDetail: A magnet or a .torrent link, through qBittorrent
add.torrentLinkNeedsClient: A .torrent link needs qBittorrent: the debrid services take magnets only.
add.waitDetail: {service} is fetching the file. The download starts here as soon as it is ready.
browse.folderInstall: Folder installs will stop getting updates soon. Install the single-file version by hand

stream.rememberDetail: For every PKG. Change it in Settings.

downloads.streamedBackground: Your PS5 is downloading it: follow it in its Downloads. You can close Overdrive.

downloads.proxyProgress: Through Overdrive: {done} of {total} ({percent}%). Keep Overdrive open.

downloads.notice.confirm: File found, confirm it in Overdrive
downloads.packagesExtracted: Packages extracted to {path}. A PKG installer is required.
downloads.panel.awake: The console stays awake until downloads finish.

errors.action.freeOrOtherDrive: Free space, or choose another drive under Save to.
errors.action.freeThenResume: Free space on the drive, then Resume.
errors.action.freeThenRetry: Free space on the drive, then Retry, or cancel and save elsewhere.
errors.action.openSource: Open the source, then enter its final file URL.
errors.action.otherSource: Cancel it and pick another source.
errors.action.installByHand: Install it by hand from downloads/packages with etaHEN or onionHEN.

errors.action.retryPart: Retry to download that part again.
errors.action.startLoaderRetry: Start your payload loader (etaHEN or an elfldr), then Retry.

errors.archivePasswordMissing: This archive needs a password the source doesn't give
errors.archivePasswordUnknown: None of the known passwords opens this archive
errors.action.passwordKeepFiles: Your downloaded files are kept: pick another source, or Retry after updating Overdrive.
errors.archiveTooLarge: This archive can't be extracted on the console
errors.consoleMemoryBusy: The console is short of free memory right now
errors.fileChanged: The file changed on the server
errors.notGameFile: The host sent a web page instead of the game
errors.pkgFirmware: PS5 fake PKGs only install on firmware 11.60 or older
errors.pkgNoLoader: The PKG is ready but couldn't be installed automatically: no payload loader on port 9021
errors.needsBrowser: This source needs a web browser
errors.noSpaceExtract: Not enough free space to extract this game
errors.action.freeThenRetryExtract: Free up space on the drive, then Retry. The download is kept.

files.deleteFailed: This file couldn't be deleted. Try again.
files.emptyDetail: Downloads land in these folders, and files you copy over FTP show up too.

files.installFailed: The console refused this package. Check that kstuff is loaded, then try again.

homebrew.about: Native PS5 apps and games from the community catalog at {source}. Each one downloads from its developer's GitHub release and is checked before it installs.
homebrew.appFailed: This app's details can't be read right now, or it's no longer in the catalog. Try again in a moment.
homebrew.failed: The homebrew catalog can't be reached right now. Check the console's connection and try again.
language.subtitle: Game titles and descriptions stay as the store lists them.
language.title: Language
search.tryGenre: Check the spelling, or try a genre:
settings.archiveDetail: Sign in to download the items of the Archive.org collections.
settings.archiveFieldBody.password: The password of your Archive.org account. It stays on this console, beside the other services' credentials.
settings.archiveFieldBody.user: The email of your Archive.org account. It is sent only to archive.org.
settings.archiveHint: Enter your Archive.org email and password.
settings.deletePackagesDetail: Frees the space once the console has installed the game. Turn it off to keep the files.
settings.diskDetail: The drive new games are saved to. It stays chosen for the games after them.
settings.speedLimitDetail: Leaves bandwidth for other devices. App updates are never limited.
settings.title: Settings
settings.vibrationDetail: A light pulse as you move, select and go back
shadowMount.offAction: The game shows up once you load it. Add it to your jailbreak's autoload to keep it on.
sort.label: Sort
sort.title: A–Z
sources.browserNote: Each part opens a host's page, then you type its file link with the controller.
sources.kind.patch: Backport files only, not the full game
sources.status.package: PS5 fake PKGs only install on firmware 11.60 or older
sources.status.patch: Needs the base game, won't install alone
sources.section.dlcNote: Extra content for the game, not the game itself.
sources.section.pageNote: Overdrive reads the file link from the page. If the host asks for a check, it sends you there.
sources.showBrowser: {count, plural, one {Show # web browser source} other {Show # web browser sources}}
sources.title: Download source
tips.title: Before you download
tips.note.dlc: This is a DLC, not the game. Install the base game first.
tips.note.patch: These are backport files only, not the full game. They won't install on their own.
tips.note.package: This is a PS5 fake PKG. It only installs on firmware 11.60 or older.
tips.note.browserViking: This source opens in the PS5 browser. Complete the verification, then wait. Don't press Download or any ad.
tips.note.browserOther: This source opens in the PS5 browser and then asks for the file's link. If you can, pick a source higher in the list.
tips.note.firmware: This version needs firmware {need} or newer. Check yours in Settings > System > System Software.
tips.tip.firmware.title: Check the firmware
tips.tip.firmware.body: Base 8.xx needs 8.xx or newer. BackPort is for older consoles.
tips.tip.fullGame.title: Get the full game
tips.tip.fullGame.body: Base or BackPort, not DLC or backport files.
tips.tip.top.title: Start from the top
tips.tip.retry.title: Failed? Try another
update.detail: A new version of Overdrive is ready. It installs in place and reopens on its own.
update.reopen: Closing. Open Overdrive again from the home screen
update.reopenInstalled: Overdrive was updated to v{version}. Close it and open it again from the home screen.
update.replaceByHand: Download update.zip from github.com/MyLuxy/overdrive, close Overdrive and copy the .exfat over the old one.
update.replaceFailed: Could not replace the installed image while Overdrive is running.
update.restartConsole: If it keeps opening the old version, restart the console.
urlDialog.controls: Square: delete · R2: confirm · Circle: cancel
versions.name: {platform} version
versions.note.ps4: Plays on PS5 through backward compatibility
versions.title: Choose version
capture.title: Vikingfile verification
capture.detail: Don't press Download or any ad: the link is captured by itself and the download starts automatically. You have 3 minutes.
capture.link.title: Download verification
capture.link.detail: Pass the check: the link is captured by itself. Cancel any download the browser starts. You have 5 minutes.
capture.confirm.title: Is this the right file?
capture.confirm.detail: The host doesn't say which game this file is. Download it only if it's the game you chose.
settings.unlinkBody: Its key is deleted from this console, and downloads through it stop until you link it again.
settings.speedUnlimitedDetail: As fast as the source allows
settings.speedSideBest: as fast as the source allows
settings.speedSideNote: Times with the source at full speed. A slower source stays slow even without a limit.
settings.diskAutoDetail: The first drive with room for the game
settings.diskSideAuto: Automatic takes the first drive with room for the game, starting with internal storage.
settings.diskSideNote: New games go here. If the drive is missing or full, the game's page offers another.
settings.pkgAskDetail: Before each download, and it can remember the answer
settings.pkgConsoleDetail: The PS5 downloads it: close Overdrive and keep using the console
settings.pkgOverdriveDetail: It downloads here, with pause and resume: Overdrive stays open
settings.cleanupSideOn: Frees the space the PKG took on the download drive. A PKG the console refuses stays, to install by hand.
settings.cleanupSideOff: The file stays in downloads/packages: useful to reinstall or copy, but it takes space.
settings.vibrationSideOn: A pulse at {level}% as you move between items.
settings.languageSideNote: The app's own parts change at once, without restarting.
settings.languageSideRtl: A right-to-left language: the interface mirrors.
settings.torboxLead: Downloads links and magnets on TorBox's servers. The key stays on this console.
settings.realdebridLead: Downloads links and magnets on Real-Debrid's servers. The token stays on this console.
settings.premiumizeLead: Downloads links and magnets on Premiumize's servers. It is set up with its API key.
settings.qbittorrentLead: Your qBittorrent, on the home network, fetches the torrents; the console takes the finished file.
settings.serviceSideLinked: The key stays on this console: it survives restarts and updates.
settings.servicePhone: Scan the code with your phone's camera, then approve Overdrive. No key to copy.
settings.qbitSideSet: The address and login stay on this console. The WebUI must be on the console's network.
settings.versionLead: The build that's running, and where updates come from.
settings.versionAvailable: v{version} is available: Overdrive will offer it.
settings.versionFailed: The check failed. Try again in a moment.
settings.versionNote: Overdrive checks at every launch, and installs the update from here.
settings.licensesLead: Overdrive is free software: these are the licenses of the app and of the projects it builds on.
settings.licensesEmpty: The notices aren't in this build.
